extDescription.message: Kill the algorithm of your social networks and bring your friends back home, safe and sound: only posts from people you follow.

x_reposts_hint.message: Reposts bring in accounts you don’t follow

yt_ads_hint.message: Banners and promoted items; skips video ads as soon as allowed

yt_shorts_hint.message: Shorts you open play as regular videos

ig_on_hint.message: Home opens the chronological feed of people you follow

li_on_hint.message: No promoted posts or authors you don’t follow

note.message: Changes apply instantly. Works in the desktop browser.

fb_on_hint.message: Friends, groups and pages you follow, no ads

tt_on_hint.message: No “For You” or suggestions from accounts you don’t follow

fb_shares_hint.message: Other people’s posts shared by your friends

fb_activity_hint.message: “X likes this”, “X and Y follow…”: picked by the algorithm

li_activity_hint.message: “X likes this”, “X commented”: picked by the algorithm

bs_on_hint.message: No Discover, Video or other feeds

reviewText.message: A rating on the Chrome Web Store helps other people find it.

donateTitle.message: Thanks for using it all this time!

donateText.message: It is free and ad-free. A voluntary donation helps keep it going and build new tools.

welcomeLead.message: From now on, your social networks show you what the accounts you follow post, not what the algorithm picks. Here is how:

step1Title.message: Pin the extension to the toolbar

step1Text.message: Click the puzzle piece icon at the top right of Chrome, then the pin next to “Dezombify”. Its settings will always be at hand.

step2Text.message: Nothing else to do: when you visit them, the extension takes you to the feed of accounts you follow and hides suggestions, recommendations and ads.

step3Text.message: Click the icon while on a network to see its options (for example, hiding what they repost). All networks and options are in Options.

welcomePrivacy.message: The extension only changes how the networks look in your browser. It doesn't read your accounts or send anything to any server.

tw_on_hint.message: No Home, recommended channels or categories

demo_hint.message: Keeps everything visible and covers ads (ADS, black) and algorithmic content (ALGORITHM, red).
